title: Phota Prompt Output Schema
description: Validation schema for prompt generation output targeting PhotaLabs Phota. Supports Generate, Edit, and Enhance modes with identity-preserving profile references.

mode.description: Operating mode. Generate = new photo from prompt. Edit = modify existing photo. Enhance = auto quality improvement (no prompt).

prompt.description: Text prompt with [[profile_id]] references. Required for Generate and Edit modes. Null for Enhance mode. NEVER describe the person's physical appearance — the profile carries identity.

items.description: Profile ID referenced in the prompt via [[profile_id]] syntax

profiles_referenced.description: List of profile_ids used in this prompt. Null for Enhance mode.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Default is 1K — must explicitly set 4K for premium output.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Auto derives from input image in Edit mode.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate per request

output_format.description: Output file format. PNG recommended for editing workflows (lossless).

url.description: Image URL or base64 data URI

purpose.description: How this input image is used

input_images.description: Input images for Edit and Enhance modes. Null for Generate mode.

identity_lock_phrases.description: Identity lock phrases used in this prompt for tracking. E.g., 'Preserve identity and facial features exactly'.

directors_notes.description: Explanation of lighting recipe, lens choice, expression direction, and edit rationale

profiles_referenced.description: At least one profile must be referenced in Generate mode

input_images.description: At least one input image required for Edit mode
Single input image for Enhance mode
